Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 140. Category: technique. Rank 2.

Rank 2 Ki technique
Ki Cost: 20
Prerequisites: none
Casting Time: 1 action
Range: 90 feet (15 foot radius)
Chargeable?: Yes
Duration: Instantaneous
Type: Barrage
Fire a single energy beam into the air that explodes
and rains down a a barrage of ki bullets down in the
area.
Choose a 5 foot space within range, all creatures of
choice in a 15 foot radius must make a dexterity saving
throw or take 3d8 ki damage on a fail, half on a success.
